## Notes · **draft**
⭐ This is the other half of the justification that "one can do derived algebra in $\mathrm{CondAb}$" (the first half being "enough injectives", supplied by the fact that it is a Grothendieck category): enough projective objects means left derived functors can also be computed directly.

> Proofs of the edges are still Chinese only: `proofs/`; the Chinese page remains authoritative.
